value.rationale: This provides a deterministic, completely specified, real symmetric optimum-rank matrix as an explicit degree-k polynomial of the natural unweighted adjacency matrix for an infinite three-parameter family, plus a sign law on every distance layer. Unlike generic-parameter Jacobi constructions, it involves no tuned weights or zero avoidance and directly certifies the nonvanishing condition in the 2026 general spectral method; the signed filter can be reused in spectral graph constructions. It is not presented as a new numerical zero-forcing or maximum-nullity invariant; its utility is the canonical spectral certificate. The k>=3 long-arm restriction excludes the known square-of-tree case.
